Where in Victoria is your truck?

Victoria wide enquiries. One direct number.

Sampson Heavy Diesel Services takes truck and heavy diesel enquiries across Victoria. Your location, access, the work required and Clive’s availability determine the arrangements. Call Clive to confirm arrangements before a booking.

If your location is not shown in the lookup, call with your nearest town, road name or map pin. Some localities share a postcode, and a postcode alone may not identify where the truck is.

Discuss your location · 0474 372 852

Melbourne and surrounding suburbs

For a truck in a depot, yard or workshop, give the suburb, access details and work required. Planned servicing and on site enquiries start with the same direct call.

Geelong and western Victoria

For Geelong, Ballarat and towns further west, describe the truck’s location and whether the work can be planned around its next run. Travel arrangements are confirmed for the job.

Central and northern Victoria

For Bendigo, Shepparton, Wodonga and surrounding towns, have the road or site address ready. Tell Clive about vehicle access and the symptoms before arranging attendance.

Gippsland and eastern Victoria

For towns and worksites across Gippsland, the nearest town and a map pin can help explain your location. Call to discuss suitability, travel and availability.

Mallee and north western Victoria

For Mildura, Swan Hill and remote locations, call with the nearest town, road and truck details. Longer travel needs to be discussed directly before a booking is confirmed.
